target.title: Scope memory dreaming sweeps by agent
target.body:
## Summary
- Add optional `plugins.entries.memory-core.config.dreaming.agents` to allowlist agent ids for Dreaming workspace sweeps.
- Apply the allowlist in shared workspace resolution, managed promotion runs, phase sweeps, and doctor status so configured filters do not fall back to unlisted workspaces.
- Keep doctor legacy-state migrations and public memory artifact discovery unscoped by Dreaming filters, so migrations and companion plugin artifact listing still see every configured memory workspace.
- Document the option, expose it in the memory-core manifest schema/UI hints, and refresh generated config/API baselines.
- Rebased onto `upstream/main` at `7d3cfa85dc`; resolved generated baseline and SDK surface budget conflicts.

## Verification
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/doctor-contract-api.test.ts src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.test.ts src/plugin-sdk/memory-host-core.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/doctor.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/config.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/public-artifacts.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/bridge.test.ts extensions/memory-wiki/src/status.test.ts` passed 4 Vitest shards: 17 unit-fast tests, 64 gateway tests, 5 plugin-sdk tests, and 156 extension-memory tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts` passed 1 tooling shard with 9 tests.
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check` passed.
- `node --import tsx scripts/generate-config-doc-baseline.ts --check` passed.
- `node --max-old-space-size=8192 --import tsx scripts/generate-plugin-sdk-api-baseline.ts --check` passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256 docs/.generated/plugin-sdk-api-baseline.sha256` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` returned clean with no accepted/actionable findings on `15bf23087441a79ebf0584ff43b58e4deb6cdb80`.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior addressed: Dreaming can be limited to selected agent ids, for example `agents: ["main"]`, instead of sweeping every configured agent workspace.

Real environment tested: Local OpenClaw source checkout on branch `codex/dreaming-agent-scope` at `15bf23087441a79ebf0584ff43b58e4deb6cdb80`, using a temporary OpenClaw config, temporary agent workspaces, and the real memory-core plugin-state SQLite test store. No provider credentials, user config, or external model calls were used; the managed cron path ran with the production fallback narrative behavior for a missing subagent runtime.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: Ran a one-off `node --import tsx --input-type=module` runtime transcript that imported `extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.ts`, `extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-state.ts`, `extensions/memory-core/src/short-term-promotion.ts`, and `src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.ts`; initialized the memory-core SQLite test store; seeded `main`, `alpha`, and `beta` workspaces with daily memory plus short-term recalls; configured `plugins.entries.memory-core.config.dreaming.agents: ["main", "alpha"]`; invoked `runShortTermDreamingPromotionIfTriggered({ trigger: "cron", ... })`; and asserted the unlisted `beta` workspace remained untouched.

Evidence after fix:

```text
resolvedWorkspaces=[{"workspace":"main","agentIds":["main"]},{"workspace":"alpha","agentIds":["alpha"]}]
trigger={"handled":true,"reason":"memory-core: short-term dreaming processed"}
main: memory=true dreams=true deepReports=1
alpha: memory=true dreams=true deepReports=1
beta: memory=false dreams=false deepReports=0
infoLogs=["memory-core: dreaming verbose enabled (cron=0 3 * * *, limit=10, minScore=0.000, minRecallCount=0, minUniqueQueries=0, recencyHalfLifeDays=14, maxAgeDays=30, workspaces=2).","memory-core: dreaming promotion complete (workspaces=2, candidates=2, applied=2, failed=0)."]
result=pass selected=main,alpha untouched=beta
```

Observed result after fix: The production Dreaming workspace resolver returned only `main` and `alpha`; the managed cron sweep wrote `MEMORY.md`, Dreaming output, and one deep report for those two workspaces; and the unlisted `beta` workspace had no `MEMORY.md`, no Dreaming output, and no deep report after the sweep.

What was not tested: A live overnight Gateway cron daemon run against a real user config with provider-backed subagent narrative generation. The proof above directly exercises the same managed cron trigger handler and workspace selection logic without waiting for the scheduled 03:00 run or calling a paid model.
